connector.name: MCP Server by thoughtspot.app
connector.registryDescription: MCP Server for ThoughtSpot - provides OAuth authentication and tools for querying data
connector.summary: Hosted at agent.thoughtspot.app over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace app.thoughtspot. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
